We offer an exciting and generous range of scholarships to support international students coming to study at CDU from around the globe. Our scholarships reward high-achieving students with outstanding academic accomplishments and who contribute to the potential to make a positive impact on the world.
Information on the scholarship application process can be found under each scholarship detailed below.
CDU offers a limited number of scholarships for international students who have a record of academic excellence and high achievement.
The scholarship applies to an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree covering 50% of the tuition fee for the full duration of the course.
The scholarship is neither transferable for cash nor refundable and cannot be transferred to another person, semester, course or year.
An application is required for this scholarship, see the details below on how to apply
Applicant must apply to commence study in S1 or S2 2026 (the intake they are offered first)
Applicant must meet the University's academic and English language entry requirements for their chosen course
Applicant must have a minimum overall score of 95% in their highest completed qualification
Applicant must be an international student paying international student fees
Applicant must not hold another scholarship from an Australian or foreign sponsoring agency
Overall score in their highest completed qualification
Supporting statements (up to 600 words) outlining why you should be awarded a scholarship
The duration of the Scholarship is the minimum time in which the course can be completed or when one of the following is true:
The maximum Scholarship value has been exhausted
You no longer meet the ongoing eligibility of the scholarship
In order to retain the scholarship, the recipient must meet all the following:
Continue to be an international student liable for international student fees
Pay their portion of the tuition fees on or before the payment due date (first day of teaching) of each semester
Maintain satisfactory academic progress each semester with a minimum GPA of 5.3 and with no fail grade in any unit
Maintain a full-time enrolment of 40 credit points (0.5 EFTSL) each semester or have the approval to reduce their study load or take a leave of absence for the semester

The CDU Global Merit Scholarship is available to new international TAFE, Undergraduate, Postgraduate (Coursework), and Higher Degree by Research students who meet the academic criteria at Charles Darwin University (CDU), Australia and commence in 2026.
The scholarship applies to the CDU course and covers 30% of the tuition fee for select courses.
No application is required. Applicants are automatically assessed after submitting their application for an eligible course.
The offer to study must be accepted in time to commence your studies in that intake. Please see
TAFE, Undergraduate, Postgraduate (Coursework), Higher Degree by Research
Pre-condition: Successful completion of most recent studies. Applicants must meet the University’s
academic and English language entry requirements
Please refer to the CDU Global Merit Scholarship terms and conditions for further details.

The CDU Bachelor of Nursing Scholarship is available to new international students who meet the entry criteria at Charles Darwin University (CDU), Australia for the Bachelor of Nursing course and commencing in 2025 and 2026.
The scholarship applies to the Bachelor of Nursing course and covers up to 20% of the tuition fee for this course
The offer to study must be accepted in time to commence your studies in that intake. These dates can be found
Please refer to the CDU Bachelor of Nursing Scholarship

CDU International College Scholarship - China and East Asia
provides scholarships to recognise and support high-achieving international students as they begin their journey to becoming graduates of Charles Darwin University.
for students from China, Hong Kong, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Cambodia, Laos, Taiwan, Korea, Thailand, Philippines, and Japan.
Applicants must be interviewed to determine if the candidate is of sufficient merit for the scholarship.
This interview will include, but not be limited to the following:
understanding the candidate's previous relevant study accomplishments
the impact Charles Darwin University may have on their future career objectives.
Consideration within the interview will also be taken on the applicant’s character, community involvement and leadership potential.
Applicants must be new full-fee paying international students.
Applicants must meet the academic and English requirements for their chosen course.
This award is exclusively for new international students.
Applicant must apply to commence study in 2026 for one of the programs offered by CDU International College
Applicants must meet the academic and English language entry requirements for their chosen course.
Students must be classified as international fee-paying students paying the full international tuition fee rate to be considered for this discount.
The discount is awarded for the first year of study only and is deducted from gross tuition fees upon enrolment.
The scholarship cannot be used in lieu of any required deposit and no cash alternative is available.

If students wish to defer their entry to the CDU International College programs to 2026, the scholarship will not be automatically transferred. However, the student will be automatically assessed with the new scholarship scheme for 2027 when it's available.
The CDU International College International Scholarships are periodically reviewed and are subject to change.
If the application is successful, we'll notify the applicant by email confirming the details of the scholarship.
CDU International College Scholarship - All Regions (excluding China and East Asia)
for students from all regions excluding China and East Asia (Hong Kong, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Cambodia, Laos, Taiwan, Korea, Thailand, Philippines, and Japan).

The 30% scholarships are competitively assessed and only granted to students who demonstrate exceptional academic performance in their studies. Students must undergo an interview with our Regional Representative to assess their eligibility. If deemed not eligible for the 30% scholarships, they will receive a 15% award.
